description: ASEP - Conexión del servicio eléctrico y del medidor is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad Nacional de los Servicios Públicos. Artículo 15, "Sección X.3.2 Conexión del servicio eléctrico y del medidor", "Título X: Normas de calidad del servicio comercial" del "Reglamento de distribución y comercialización de energía eléctrica" (RDC). Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Autoridad Nacional de los Servicios Públicos . Its tags are electricidad, servicio comercial. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2021-07-02 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
